DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: temporary defenses
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: Earthworks, firing steps and improvised barricades provide a modest defensive position.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: fortifications
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: Hardened firing positions and prepared strongpoints provide reliable protection against attack.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: A protected shell store that adds three rounds to every bombardment fired by this outpost.
